blind.B1: Yes, as a secondary use: GSE126001 is a public in vivo chronic-exercise dataset the paper reuses (TAB1, S4.9.p1, S3.p4). Exercise factor = train (TR vs UT) in all 16 gastrocnemius samples (WT 4+4, Il13-/- 4+4); the paper uses the WT mice only.
blind.B2: Paper has no formal comparison for this series; TAB1 lists 20-week WT male mice, 5 weeks treadmill vs sedentary (WT 4 vs 4 by GEO titles). Used for classifier test (S2.1.p3) and signature-gene direction (S2.2.p2, FIG3a,b).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one gastrocnemius per mouse; mouse id is unique per sample; packet A lists no pairing keys.
blind.B4: Paper does not say how GSE126001 was modelled (no DE for public sets).
blind.B5: No DE rule for public datasets; FIG3 legend only excludes genes with log2 CPM < 1 and sorts by fold difference. (EPS rule elsewhere: P<0.01, FC>2, S2.1.p1; Methods S4.6.p1 P<0.001, FC>=2.) No DEG counts reported for GSE126001.

checks.evidence: Ran WT TR vs UT as primary, KO exploratory; matches B1/TAB1.
train UT 8/TR 8 from titles agree with treatment characteristic; WT subset 4 vs 4, no exclusions; control = untrained of same genotype.
TR vs UT (treatment vs control) in design and DEG file name.
One muscle per mouse, no pairing key (packet A); repeated_measure_unit none.
Paper silent; stratified two-group fits within genotype, ~train, reasoned in design gate.
Genotype crossed 4/4 per cell and handled by stratification; no batch recorded.
RPKM (CLC), non-integer, max 19257; limma on log2(RPKM+1) is the declared route; deviation recorded.
Paper gives no rule; workflow default BH<0.05 labelled workflow_default, audit rule recorded.
paper_counts empty, no count comparison claimed; gene-direction check reported honestly incl. genes not following signature.
No stop or refusal in this case.

summary: 该系列是论文复用的公共体内运动数据集,分析取 WT 训练组对未训练组(4 vs 4)作为主对比,KO 作探索性,方向、分组、矩阵路线与阈值来源均如实记录。论文未报告该数据集的 DEG 数,因此没有数值对照,HANDBACK 也未过度声称。未发现需要修改的项目。
